title: Plan Invoice Reissue Reference — Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
When the plan on a Real Estate Service Contracts order is changed before closing, the earlier invoice is credited in full and the reissued plan invoice is issued at the reissued plan premium. For a plan invoice reissued after a plan change before closing this rule sets the invoiced amount, and only for such an invoice; every other plan invoice still equals the plan's base premium, plus the oversize surcharge when the square footage is at or above the oversize threshold, plus the additional dwelling unit premium for each dwelling unit beyond the first, minus the condominium or townhome deduction when the property type is condominium or townhome. The plan ordered may still be changed to another plan at any time before closing, and the invoice is then reissued at the reissued plan premium; only such a reissued invoice is priced this way.

The plan premium is invoiced only on an order in status listing coverage or awaiting closing. A plan invoice reissued after a plan change before closing is due on the expected closing date shown on the order, and only such an invoice; every other plan invoice remains due on the closing date.

| Order status | Plan premium invoicing |
|---|---|
| listing coverage | permitted |
| awaiting closing | permitted |
| any other status | not invoiced |

In the order's billing history, the earlier invoice credited in full on a plan change shows as credited by a plan-change credit memo, and the reissued plan invoice shows as the open plan invoice.

## Invocation: `reissue_plan_invoice_480f4e9f`

**Capability.** Issues a new plan premium invoice on a real estate plan that has not yet closed, for the plan now on the order. One call posts one plan invoice to the plan's billing history, dated today, for the premium given, payable at the expected closing date shown on the order, and raises the plan's invoice balance by that amount. A new plan invoice number is issued and returned; the invoice then shows in the plan's billing history as the open plan invoice. The tool books the amount it is given exactly; it checks no eligibility, order or status itself.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reissue_plan_invoice_480f4e9f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `realty_contract_id` | the real estate contract (plan) number of the order being invoiced, as shown by the real estate contract lookup for the buyer | identifier text |
| `amount` | the plan premium to invoice | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; booked exactly as given |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries: `status` "invoiced" when the invoice was posted; `invoice_number`, the new plan invoice number (text); `realty_contract_id`, the plan number invoiced; `amount`, the premium invoiced in USD with 2 decimal places; `entry_date`, today's invoice date as YYYY-MM-DD; `due_date`, the payment due date (the expected closing date on the order) as YYYY-MM-DD; `invoice_balance`, the plan's invoice balance after the invoice in USD with 2 decimal places.
